name: The Tick, The Ambulance and the God-Eater
source:
After recovering from burnout, Molly finally managed to invite her friends on a hiking trip. Join the three of them as they discover each other's darkest secrets, and take on the monsters lurking in the forest.

[From [url=https://nothack-europa.itch.io/the-tick-the-ambulance-and-the-god-eater]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
好不容易從身心俱疲的狀態中恢復過來，莫莉終於約上朋友們一起去健行。跟隨三人走進森林，發現彼此藏得最深的秘密，迎戰潛伏在林中的怪物。

［摘自[url=https://nothack-europa.itch.io/the-tick-the-ambulance-and-the-god-eater]itch.io[/url]］
